headlines.title: Trump order aims to cut number of diseases all children should be vaccinated against from 18 to 11
headlines.description: The order reaffirms the dramatic overhaul to the vaccine schedule that Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced this year. Those changes have been blocked in court.

headlines.title: RFK Jr. wants to fix loophole that allows additives into food. Critics say it doesn’t go far enough.
headlines.description: The Trump administration said it’s taking first steps in strengthening rules over ingredients food companies have long added to their products with minimal oversight.

headlines.title: New food items recalled over salmonella outbreak
headlines.description: Taylor Farms is voluntarily recalling items like salsa and guacamole all over the country. The recall is hitting store shelves in 26 states. The CDC and FDA have been investigating the salmonella outbreak which has sickened 345 people. NBC News’ Steve Patterson has the story.

headlines.title: Trump signs order to change child vaccine recommendations
headlines.description: President Trump signed an executive order that would change the recommendations for childhood vaccines. He said the new recommendations give more choices to parents. But top pediatricians said it could spark dangerous confusion. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Trump signs executive order on childhood vaccines
headlines.description: President Trump signed an executive order that aims to reduce the number of universally recommend vaccines for children and separate the MMR vaccine into individual shots. NBC News' Monica Alba and Dr. Akshay Syal have details on the order and the changes it could bring to a child's vaccine schedule.

headlines.title: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announces move to define ultraprocessed foods
headlines.description: The Department of Health and Human Services is moving to officially define what makes certain foods "ultraprocessed." NBC News medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar reports on what Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. had to say about the foods at an event and what it means for your groceries.

headlines.title: West Nile virus season peaks in late August — here’s what you can use to stay safe
headlines.description: West Nile virus cases typically peak in late summer. Here’s how it spreads, the symptoms to watch for and expert-backed tips to avoid mosquito bites.

headlines.title: Dermstore Anniversary Sale: The best deals to shop this week
headlines.description: Dermstore’s Anniversary Sale includes deals of up to 25% off bestselling brands like Cosrx, Sunday Riley, Supergoop and more.

headlines.title: You won’t want to wait until winter to return these recalled handwarmers — here’s why
headlines.description: Ocoopa has recalled 1.5 million rechargeable hand warmers after reports of fires, burns and one death. Here’s what happened, how to check your device and safer alternatives.

headlines.title: The best self-emptying cordless stick vacuums you should know about
headlines.description: I spoke to several home appliance and vacuum experts to find the best self-emptying vacuums, including ones from top brands like Dyson and Shark.

headlines.title: Louisiana warns against flesh-eating bacteria after five deaths
headlines.description: Louisiana health officials are urging residents to take precautions against a flesh-eating bacterial infection following the deaths of five people this year.

headlines.title: How 3 health factors can help delay dementia for up to 13 years
headlines.description: New research from NYU Langone Health found that people who avoid three vascular risk factors in middle age had about 13 more dementia-free years.
